origin_year_or_period.value: recreated 1980-1985 from an older regional breed

value: one of the tallest chicken breeds native to Europe
iridescent beetle-black plumage, oversized comb and wattles, white skin and blue legs
meat has a reputation for a gamey flavor and is protected under a regional quality label

history_summary.value: The Barbezieux is a French breed considered rare, recreated by four breeders between 1980 and 1985 after near-disappearance. It is raised mainly in its region of origin around Barbezieux under the 'Poulet de race Barbezieux' quality label, prized for firm, gamey meat.
